simple.meaning: to give , used with greatest latitude of application ( put , make , etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָתַן (H5414) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2015 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נָתַן (nâthan) means to give , used with greatest latitude of application ( put , make , etc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 2 35.
